description: Capability catalog for the bizops multi-agent team. Business-agnostic: every task is expressed in generic terms (items, customers, orders).

status.supported: all required tools exist in the built-in MCP server today
status.partial: core of the task works today; tools_missing add precision or automation
status.planned: needs tools that do not exist yet

how_to_use.needs_approval: true when the task writes data; the runtime pauses for the owner (profile.approval_required must list the write tools)
how_to_use.example_requests: also usable as routing examples / eval prompts

sales.description: Orders, quotes, products & prices, customers, sales reporting, targets.

tasks.name: Product & price lookup
tasks.description: Find products by name/SKU/category with price and availability.
example_requests: How much is the Premium Widget?
What do we sell in the bundles category?
Do we have Kopi C in stock?

tasks.name: Check availability for a customer request
tasks.description: Confirm requested quantities can be fulfilled before promising delivery.
example_requests: Can I take 30 Standard Widgets today?
Is there enough stock for an order of 5 gift cards?

tasks.name: Create / take an order
tasks.description: Create a paid order for a customer with one or more lines; stock is decremented, fails safely if stock is short.
example_requests: Order 2 Starter Packs for Alex Tan
Add an order for Siti: 1 Premium Widget and 3 Standard Widgets

tasks.name: Repeat a customer's previous order
tasks.description: Look up the customer's last order and re-create it.
example_requests: Same as Alex's last order please
Repeat Aisyah's Friday office order

tasks.name: Look up orders
tasks.description: List recent orders, filter by customer, and report totals/status.
example_requests: Show orders from the last 3 days
What did Siti order recently?

tasks.name: Show full detail of one order
tasks.description: Lines, quantities, discounts and payment status for a single order.
example_requests: What was in order 42?
Show me the lines of the last order

tasks.name: Cancel an order / return stock
tasks.description: Cancel an order, return items to stock and flag a refund for finance.
example_requests: Cancel order 37, customer changed their mind
Void the last order and put the stock back

tasks.name: Apply a discount within policy
tasks.description: Apply a percentage/amount discount to an order if within the owner's policy, otherwise escalate.
example_requests: Give Alex 10% off order 12
Can we do RM5 off for this loyal customer?

tasks.name: Prepare a quote / estimate
tasks.description: Price a basket for a customer without creating an order; optionally draft the quote message.
example_requests: Quote 50 Standard Widgets for a company order
How much for 10 Kopi O and 5 Matcha for tomorrow's office?
tasks.notes: Basic quoting works today via list_items + arithmetic + draft_message; create_quote adds tracking and validity.

tasks.name: Sales summary for a period
tasks.description: Revenue, order count, gross profit and top sellers for the last N days.
example_requests: How were sales this week?
Revenue for the last 30 days?

tasks.name: Daily sales close
tasks.description: End-of-day summary: today's orders, revenue, best seller, items that sold out.
example_requests: Close out today's sales
What did we sell today?

tasks.name: Best and worst sellers
tasks.description: Rank items by units/revenue and highlight laggards.
example_requests: What are our top 5 sellers this month?
Which items aren't selling?

tasks.name: Sales by custom range / grouping
tasks.description: Sales between any two dates, grouped by day/week/month/item/category/customer.
example_requests: Compare sales between 1-15 Nov and 16-30 Nov
Sales per category in October

tasks.name: Customer lookup & history
tasks.description: Find a customer and summarise their contact, notes and recent purchases.
example_requests: Who is Siti Rahman?
Show Alex's purchase history

tasks.name: Top / VIP customers
tasks.description: Rank customers by spend or frequency.
example_requests: Who are my top 10 customers?
Which customers order most often?

tasks.name: Add or update a customer
tasks.description: Create a customer record or update contact/notes.
example_requests: Add a new customer: Daniel, 012-345 6789
Note that Aisyah prefers oat milk

tasks.name: Upsell / cross-sell suggestions
tasks.description: Suggest add-ons or bundles based on what sells together and current stock.
example_requests: What should I offer a customer buying a Starter Pack?
Suggest a bundle for office orders

tasks.name: Sales targets & progress
tasks.description: Set and track revenue/order/profit targets.
example_requests: Set a RM5,000 revenue target for November
Are we on track for this month's target?

tasks.name: Add or change products and prices
tasks.description: Create items, change prices/costs, archive items.
example_requests: Add a new item: Iced Hojicha, RM13, cost RM4.5
Raise Kopi O to RM6.50

inventory.description: Stock levels, reorder planning, suppliers & purchase orders, stock adjustments, stocktakes, item catalogue.

tasks.name: Check stock levels
tasks.description: Current stock for one item, a category or everything.
example_requests: How many Kopi C do we have?
Show stock for all widgets

tasks.name: Low-stock alert
tasks.description: Items at or below reorder level with suggested reorder quantities.
example_requests: What's running low?
Which items do I need to reorder?

tasks.name: Build a reorder plan
tasks.description: Combine low stock with recent sales to propose quantities per item (and budget).
example_requests: Make a reorder list for this week
What should I buy, and roughly how much will it cost?

tasks.name: Record a restock
tasks.description: Add received stock to an item with a reason/reference.
example_requests: Add 50 Kopi C, delivery arrived today
We received 20 Standard Widgets

tasks.name: Write off damaged / expired / lost stock
tasks.description: Remove stock with a reason for the audit trail; refuses to go negative.
example_requests: Write off 3 spilled matcha
Remove 2 Premium Widgets, damaged in transit

tasks.name: Stock movement history
tasks.description: Trace how an item's stock changed (sales, restocks, write-offs).
example_requests: Why did Standard Widget stock drop this week?
Show all write-offs this month

tasks.name: Stock-out forecast / days of cover
tasks.description: Estimate when each item runs out based on sales velocity.
example_requests: When will we run out of Kopi O?
Which items have less than 5 days of cover?

tasks.name: Slow movers & dead stock
tasks.description: Find items with little or no sales so cash isn't tied up.
example_requests: What hasn't sold in 30 days?
Which products should I clear out?

tasks.name: ABC classification
tasks.description: Rank items by revenue contribution (A/B/C) to focus attention.
example_requests: Which items make up 80% of revenue?
Classify my stock into A/B/C

tasks.name: Stock valuation
tasks.description: Value of stock on hand at cost and retail.
example_requests: How much money is tied up in stock?
What's my inventory worth?
tasks.notes: list_items does not return cost today; stock_valuation (or adding cost to list_items) is needed for accuracy.

tasks.name: Stocktake / reconciliation
tasks.description: Compare physical counts with system stock and book variances.
example_requests: Here are my counts: Kopi O 55, Kopi C 7 ... reconcile
Do a stocktake for widgets

tasks.name: Add a new item
tasks.description: Register a new product/ingredient with price, cost, opening stock and reorder level.
example_requests: Add oat milk 1L, cost RM9, reorder at 6
Create SKU P-005 Deluxe Pack

tasks.name: Tune reorder levels
tasks.description: Recommend and set reorder levels from demand and lead time.
example_requests: Is my reorder level for Kopi O sensible?
Set reorder levels based on last month's sales

tasks.name: Supplier lookup & management
tasks.description: Find suppliers, lead times, what each supplies, add/update suppliers.
example_requests: Who supplies our matcha?
What's the lead time for cups?

tasks.name: Draft / raise a purchase order
tasks.description: Turn a reorder plan into a purchase order for a supplier.
example_requests: Create a PO for my matcha supplier for the low items
Draft an order to the cup supplier

tasks.name: Receive a purchase order
tasks.description: Receive delivered goods against a PO: increases stock and records what's owed.
example_requests: PO 7 arrived, 2 boxes short
Receive PO 12 in full

tasks.name: Shrinkage / wastage report
tasks.description: Quantify write-offs and unexplained variances by item and reason.
example_requests: How much did we waste this month?
Where are we losing stock?

finance.description: P&L, expenses, margins, budgets, cash-flow, invoices/receivables, forecasting, exports.

tasks.name: Profit & loss summary
tasks.description: Revenue, gross profit, expenses and net profit for the last N days.
example_requests: How profitable were we in the last 30 days?
Give me this month's P&L

tasks.name: P&L for any date range / compare periods
tasks.description: P&L between two dates and month-over-month comparison.
example_requests: Compare October vs November profit
P&L for 1–15 Nov

tasks.name: Revenue report
tasks.description: Revenue and order counts with top sellers.
example_requests: What's our revenue this week?
Revenue per day over the last 14 days

tasks.name: List and review expenses
tasks.description: List expenses by period and search by category/note.
example_requests: Show all expenses this month
What did I spend on supplies?

tasks.name: Record an expense
tasks.description: Log a business expense with category and note.
example_requests: Record RM85 for milk from the wholesaler
Add a petrol expense of 40

tasks.name: Expense breakdown by category
tasks.description: Totals per category with share of spend and trend.
example_requests: Where is my money going?
Break down last month's expenses

tasks.name: Unusual expense detection
tasks.description: Flag outliers, duplicates and sudden category jumps.
example_requests: Anything weird in my spending?
Did I pay for the same thing twice?

tasks.name: Profit margin per item
tasks.description: Gross margin per item to find winners and money-losers.
example_requests: Which items make the most profit?
What's my margin on matcha latte?

tasks.name: Price & margin check
tasks.description: Test a proposed price/discount against cost and target margin.
example_requests: If I give 15% off Premium Widgets, do I still profit?
What price gives a 60% margin?
tasks.notes: Works from price/cost if cost is exposed; currently approximate.

tasks.name: Break-even analysis
tasks.description: Units/revenue needed to cover fixed costs.
example_requests: How many orders do I need per month to break even?
What's my break-even revenue?

tasks.name: Cash-flow overview
tasks.description: Cash in vs out, upcoming payables, runway estimate.
example_requests: Do I have enough cash for next month's restock?
Show cash in vs out this month

tasks.name: Budgets & budget-vs-actual
tasks.description: Set monthly budgets per category and track overspend.
example_requests: Set a RM300 monthly supplies budget
Am I over budget this month?

tasks.name: Revenue / profit forecast
tasks.description: Project the next weeks from recent run-rate and trend.
example_requests: What will revenue be next month?
Forecast profit for December

tasks.name: Invoices & receipts
tasks.description: Generate an invoice/receipt for an order and draft it to the customer.
example_requests: Make an invoice for order 31
Send Aisyah her receipt

tasks.name: Unpaid orders / receivables
tasks.description: Who owes money, how old, and chasing reminders.
example_requests: Who hasn't paid me?
Draft reminders for overdue invoices

tasks.name: Supplier payables
tasks.description: What is owed to suppliers and when.
example_requests: What bills are due this week?
How much do I owe suppliers?

tasks.name: Process refunds
tasks.description: Record a refund linked to a cancelled/returned order.
example_requests: Refund order 37
How much have we refunded this month?

tasks.name: Tax / SST estimate
tasks.description: Estimate tax payable from revenue and expenses using the configured rate.
example_requests: Estimate my tax for this quarter
How much SST did I collect?
tasks.notes: Needs a tax-rate setting in the profile; estimates only, not tax advice.

tasks.name: Export reports
tasks.description: Export P&L, expenses or sales to CSV for an accountant.
example_requests: Export last month's expenses to CSV
Give my accountant the November P&L

support.description: Tickets, customer context, complaint resolution proposals, reply drafts, follow-ups, FAQs. Drafts only - never sends.
out_of_scope: issuing refunds itself (hands off to finance/sales)

tasks.name: Review open tickets
tasks.description: List open/closed tickets with customer, age and draft replies.
example_requests: Any open support tickets?
Show closed tickets this week

tasks.name: Log a ticket
tasks.description: Open a ticket from a customer message/complaint.
example_requests: Log a complaint from Alex: wrong item delivered
Create a ticket: Siti asks about delivery time

tasks.name: Update / close a ticket
tasks.description: Change status or store a reply draft on a ticket.
example_requests: Close ticket 3, resolved
Save this reply on ticket 5

tasks.name: Draft a reply to a customer
tasks.description: Read the ticket + customer + order history and write a polite, specific reply draft (never sent).
example_requests: Draft a reply to ticket 1
Write an apology to Alex for the wrong item

tasks.name: Customer context before replying
tasks.description: One-page view of who the customer is, recent orders and open issues.
example_requests: Give me context on Alex before I reply
What has Siti ordered and complained about?

tasks.name: Investigate an order problem
tasks.description: Check order contents, stock and timing against what the customer claims.
example_requests: Customer says they got 1 instead of 2 — check the order
Why was order 14 delayed?

tasks.name: Propose resolution (refund / replace / credit)
tasks.description: Suggest the cheapest acceptable fix within policy and hand off execution.
example_requests: What should we offer for the wrong item?
Refund or replacement for ticket 4?

tasks.name: Prioritise & tag tickets
tasks.description: Rank tickets by urgency/impact and tag by reason.
example_requests: Which tickets should I handle first?
Tag all open tickets by issue type

tasks.name: Overdue / unanswered tickets
tasks.description: Find tickets older than the response target.
example_requests: Which tickets have waited more than 24 hours?
Anything I forgot to answer?

tasks.name: Answer common questions
tasks.description: Answer FAQs (hours, delivery, returns, allergens) from the knowledge base.
example_requests: What's our return policy?
Do we deliver to Petra Jaya?
tasks.notes: Until a knowledge base exists, the agent can only answer from the profile's policies.

tasks.name: Reply templates library
tasks.description: Reuse approved wording for apology, delay, refund, welcome and thank-you messages.
example_requests: Use the delay template for ticket 6
Show me the apology templates

tasks.name: Notify customers of a delay
tasks.description: Draft proactive notices to all affected customers.
example_requests: Tell everyone with open orders that we're delayed one day
Draft a stock-shortage notice for Kopi C orders

tasks.name: Follow-up / satisfaction check
tasks.description: Draft a thank-you and feedback request after an order or resolved ticket.
example_requests: Follow up with Alex after the fix
Ask last week's customers for feedback

tasks.name: Escalate to the owner
tasks.description: Summarise a tricky case with facts, options and a recommendation.
example_requests: Summarise ticket 8 for me, I need to decide
What's the situation with the angry customer?

tasks.name: Support trends & insights
tasks.description: Common complaint reasons, volume trends and fixes to prevent them.
example_requests: What do customers complain about most?
Are tickets going up?

tasks.name: Delivery / pickup status
tasks.description: Tell the customer where their order is.
example_requests: Where is Aisyah's order?
Has order 22 been delivered?

marketing.description: Promotions, campaigns, social/WhatsApp/email copy, segmentation, loyalty, campaign measurement. Drafts only.

tasks.name: Promotion ideas from real data
tasks.description: Propose promotions based on best sellers, slow movers and low-stock items.
example_requests: What promo should I run this week?
Ideas to boost sales on slow days

tasks.name: Clearance / slow-mover campaign
tasks.description: Design a offer to move slow stock while protecting margin.
example_requests: Plan a promo to clear Standard Widgets
How can I sell the extra beans?

tasks.name: New product launch plan
tasks.description: Announcement copy, timeline and channels for a new item.
example_requests: Launch plan for the new Hojicha latte
Announce our new bundle

tasks.name: Social media posts & captions
tasks.description: Short on-brand posts with caption and hashtag options for Instagram/Facebook/TikTok.
example_requests: Write 3 Instagram captions for matcha latte
Facebook post for the weekend promo

tasks.name: WhatsApp / SMS broadcast
tasks.description: Short broadcast message to a customer list (draft only).
example_requests: Draft a WhatsApp blast for office-order customers
Short SMS for Friday promo

tasks.name: Email newsletter
tasks.description: Subject lines and body for a newsletter using real products and offers.
example_requests: Write November's newsletter
Subject line options for the promo email

tasks.name: Product descriptions
tasks.description: Menu/product descriptions, taglines and bundle names.
example_requests: Write a description for House Beans 250g
Name a new gift bundle

tasks.name: Content calendar
tasks.description: Plan a week/month of posts around sales patterns and events.
example_requests: Make a 2-week content calendar
What should I post this month?

tasks.name: Seasonal & holiday campaigns
tasks.description: Campaign ideas around holidays and local events.
example_requests: What can I run for Christmas?
Plan a Hari Raya promo

tasks.name: Customer segmentation
tasks.description: Group customers into new/loyal/at-risk/lapsed/big spenders for targeting.
example_requests: Who are my loyal customers?
Segment customers for a campaign

tasks.name: Win-back lapsed customers
tasks.description: Find customers who stopped ordering and draft a tailored offer.
example_requests: Who hasn't ordered in 60 days?
Draft a win-back message with a small discount

tasks.name: Loyalty & referral program design
tasks.description: Design points/stamp/referral mechanics and check they stay profitable.
example_requests: Design a loyalty card for regulars
Referral offer: what can I afford?

tasks.name: Create a promo code
tasks.description: Create a code with validity, cap and margin floor.
example_requests: Create code NOV10 for 10% off until 30 Nov
Free-delivery code for office orders

tasks.name: Campaign plan
tasks.description: Goal, audience, offer, channel, schedule, budget and success metric for a campaign.
example_requests: Plan a campaign to grow weekday sales
Build a plan to get 20 new customers

tasks.name: Measure campaign results
tasks.description: Compare sales during a campaign vs baseline and compute ROI.
example_requests: Did the weekend promo work?
What was the ROI of the Instagram campaign?

tasks.name: A/B copy variants
tasks.description: Produce variants of a message/headline to test.
example_requests: Give me 3 variants of this promo message
Which headline is stronger?

tasks.name: Request reviews & testimonials
tasks.description: Draft polite review requests to happy customers.
example_requests: Ask recent customers for a Google review
Draft a testimonial request

tasks.name: Competitor & market scan
tasks.description: Look up competitor prices/offers and local trends.
example_requests: What do other cafes in Kuching charge for matcha?
Trending promo ideas right now

tasks.name: Design brief for poster / menu
tasks.description: A clear brief (copy, layout notes, brand tone) to hand to a designer or image tool.
example_requests: Brief for a Raya promo poster
Write copy for a new menu board

steps.do: daily sales summary and sold-out items
record today's expenses; compute day profit
campaign results and next-week promo idea

cross_agent_workflows.name: Low stock -> reorder; slow stock -> promo

steps.do: P&L, expense breakdown, budget vs actual

get_order.description: Full detail of one order: lines, customer, status, payment.

update_item.signature: update_item(sku, name?, price?, cost?, reorder_level?, category?, active?)
update_item.description: Change price, cost, reorder level, name or archive an item.

cancel_order.description: Cancel an order, optionally returning stock, and mark it for refund.

apply_discount.description: Apply a discount to an order (policy limit enforced server-side).

create_quote.description: Create a priced quote without touching stock.

generate_invoice.description: Produce invoice/receipt text (and number) for an order.

customer_ranking.description: Top customers by spend or frequency.

inactive_customers.description: Customers with no order in the last N days (win-back list).

item_margins.description: Revenue, units, gross margin % per item.

sales_by_period.description: Sales grouped over an arbitrary date range.

financial_summary_range.description: P&L for an arbitrary date range (existing tool only supports trailing days).

stock_history.description: Stock movements (sales, restocks, write-offs) from the stock log.

days_of_cover.description: Per-item stock days remaining based on recent sales velocity.

slow_movers.description: Items with little or no recent sales (dead stock candidates).

stock_valuation.description: Stock on hand valued at cost and at retail.

record_stocktake.description: Reconcile physical counts vs system and log variances.

list_suppliers.description: Suppliers with contact, lead time, items supplied.

create_purchase_order.description: Create a purchase order (draft) for restocking.

receive_purchase_order.description: Receive goods: increases stock, records payable.

set_budget.description: Set a monthly budget per expense category.

list_receivables.description: Unpaid/partially paid orders and invoices with age.

record_payment.description: Record a customer payment against an order.

list_payables.description: Money owed to suppliers with due dates.

tag_ticket.description: Add category tags and priority to a ticket.

ticket_stats.description: Ticket volumes by tag, time-to-resolve, backlog.

create_campaign.signature: create_campaign(name, goal, channel, start, end, offer, audience)
create_campaign.description: Register a marketing campaign for tracking.

campaign_results.description: Orders and revenue attributed to a campaign window/code.

create_promo_code.description: Create a promo code (margin floor enforced).

customer_segments.description: RFM-style segments: new, loyal, at-risk, lapsed, big spenders.

web_search.description: Public web lookup (competitor prices, trends, holidays). Needs an external MCP search server.

export_csv.description: Export a report to a CSV file (e.g. via filesystem MCP).

general_capabilities_all_agents: Explain any number it reports (how it was computed)
Summarise results as short bullet points or a table
Ask a clarifying question when a required detail (customer, SKU, quantity, amount) is missing
Refuse and escalate when a request breaks the profile's policies
Never invent data; say when a tool is missing
